title: Medical Hardship Supplement Claim — Riverbend Charges of the Twelve Months
content:
## The medical debt a hardship supplement claims

Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), the medical debt a hardship supplement claims is every patient liability posted on the patient's Riverbend accounts in the twelve whole months before the signing day, less every patient-balance adjustment posted in those same months. A whole month runs from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it; a posting belongs to the twelve months when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the signing day, so that a posting dated on the signing day's day of the month twelve months earlier is already outside. The supplement's claim is rounded half-up to the cent and is never below zero.

### Inputs

| Input | Where it is read | Window |
|---|---|---|
| Patient liabilities | every patient-liability posting on the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) ledgers | the 12 whole months before the signing day |
| Patient-balance adjustments | every adjustment posting on the same ledgers | the same 12 whole months |

### Window boundary (hypothetical signing day 2030-06-15)

| Posting date | Whole months to the signing day | Counted? |
|---|---|---|
| 2029-06-16 | 11 | yes |
| 2029-06-15 | 12 | no — already outside |

### Worked example (hypothetical)

Liabilities posted in the twelve months: 6,000.00. Adjustments posted in the twelve months: 2,000.00. The claim is 6,000.00 less 2,000.00, that is 4,000.00.

If the adjustments of the twelve months were 7,000.00 against the same 6,000.00 of liabilities, the difference would be below zero and the claim is 0.00.
